solution.text: Time constant is the time of free fall of a body under gravity in the viscous medium, during which the velocity of the body increases to <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><mn>63</mn><mo>%</mo></math> of the terminal velocity. Dimensionally, none of the alternatives have dimensions of time.
